actus.title: Pierre Leboucher : “it is a completely magic course! ”
actus.excerpt: Beneath a sun as radiant as the smile he wears, Pierre Leboucher crossed the finish line in third place aboard his Class40, *Institut Imagine*. A podium finish in the Route du Rhum and a Jules Verne Trophy—both in the same year—make for an impressive calling card for his next project: the 2028 Vendée Globe.

actus.title: Class40 winner Achille Nebout: “I sailed the race of my life”
actus.excerpt: As he pulls up to the victory pontoon and savors his first ‘ti’punch, Achille Nebout just can’t quite believe it. Beaming across his salt and sweat encrusted face with his two-and-a-half-year-old daughter in his arms, he snacks voraciously on fresh fruit, sitting cross-legged on the deck of Amarris.

actus.title: Masa Suzuki finishes 15th in imoca, first japanese IMOCA skipper ever to complete the race
actus.excerpt: In the quiet, small hours of the morning Japanese solo skipper Masa Suzuki, racing Milai Furuno, crossed the finish of the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe to take 15th place in the IMOCA class on the 3542 nautical miles solo Transatlantic ocean sprint from Saint Malo to Guadeloupe.
